items.title: Ileum marker list misfits colon epithelium
items.text: This section is sigmoid colon but uses the ileum list. Goblet cells take 40% of the epithelium (5,486 cells), and their markers ITLN1, REP15 and ERN2 are detected in 53–72% of the other epithelial cells; two goblet sub-clusters (1,939 cells) are SLC26A3+ CA1+ CEACAM7+ colonocytes. The Enterocyte markers APOB and MGAM (small intestine) are in 15% and 6% of the cells. Use colon markers: colonocytes (SLC26A3, CA1, CEACAM7, AQP8) and goblet cells without the ileal ITLN1.

action.request: Refine the marker list for colon (sample 167799): colonocyte markers for Enterocytes, colon goblet markers, checked with type_structure shares.

check.reason: The goblet type is inflated and mixed with colonocytes; ileal enterocyte markers are barely detected.
check.evidence: review_markers v2: Goblet ITLN1 94% vs 72%, REP15 69% vs 53%, ERN2 88% vs 65%, SPINK4 21%; type_structure Goblet /3 and /4 = 1,939 cells SLC26A3 88%, CA1 95%, CEACAM7 66% (spatial clustering 2.6 and 5.0); Enterocytes APOB 15%, MGAM 6%, SLC26A3 98%, AQP8 75%.

items.title: All CD4 T cells called Tregs
items.text: 352 of 353 CD4 T cells are Tregs, but FOXP3 is in 12% and CTLA4 in 32%; Effector/memory CD4 T cells have 1 cell. The Effector/memory markers (CD40LG, CCL5, CD69 all required) fail here, so the conventional CD4 T cells fall to Tregs. Loosen the Effector/memory markers so most CD4 T cells are not Tregs.

action.request: Fix the CD4 T cell split for colon 167799: Effector/memory markers that this section detects.

check.reason: Almost all CD4 T cells are Tregs while FOXP3 is rare; not a spill-over effect.
check.evidence: review_markers: CD4 T 353 cells, Tregs 352, Effector/memory 1; FOXP3 12%, CTLA4 32%; type_structure Tregs: no FOXP3-high sub-cluster (one sub-cluster is cycling, another has fibroblast spill-over).

items.title: γδ T and NK cells are CD8 T cells
items.text: 'gd T cells' (120) have TRDC in 7% and CD160 in 6% but CD8A in 86%; 'NK cells' (143) have KLRF1 in 10% and CD3D in 50%, with EOMES, GZMK and GZMH. Both look like cytotoxic CD8 T cells (CD8 T vs gd T confusion 0.31). The ileal IEL markers do not fit this colon section.

action.request: Make CD8 T / gd T / NK cells separable in colon 167799 (likely merge gd T and NK into CD8 T).

check.reason: Both types lack their defining genes and carry CD8/T-cell genes; the confusion is high.
check.evidence: gd T: TRDC 7%, CD160 6%, CD8A 86%, CD8B 37%; NK: KLRF1 10%, NCAM1 10%, CD3D 50%, EOMES 59%, GZMK 77%; type_confusion CD8 vs gd T 0.31, CD8 vs NK 0.25; NK is one uniform sub-cluster (type_structure).

items.title: Arterial EC missed, sitting in Unassigned
items.text: 191 Unassigned cells are BMX+ (72%), HEY1+ (49%), NOTCH4+ and PECAM1+, i.e. arterial EC, next to pericytes; the 97 cells called Arterial EC are ACKR1+ (90%) and HEY1+ in 1%, venous-like. Arterial markers BMX/HEY1 without requiring GJA4 would catch them.

action.request: Fix the Arterial EC markers for colon 167799 (BMX, HEY1, IGFBP3).

check.reason: A clear arterial EC group is unassigned while the 'Arterial EC' are venous-like.
check.evidence: type_structure Unassigned /1: 140 cells NOTCH4 86%, HEY1 66%, IL33 84%; review_markers Arterial EC (97): HEY1 1%, GJA4 6%, ACKR1 90%; Arterial vs Venous confusion 0.33.

items.title: cDC2 are cycling cDC1
items.text: 'cDC2' (47) are CLEC9A+ (89%) and CLEC10A+ in 2%, with MKI67, TOP2A and RRM2: they are proliferating cDC1 (cDC1 vs cDC2 confusion 0.44). Merge them into cDC1 or drop cDC2 for this section.

action.request: Merge cDC2 into cDC1 for colon 167799.

check.reason: cDC2 carry the cDC1 marker and lack the cDC2 one.
check.evidence: review_markers: cDC2 CLEC9A 89%, CLEC10A 2%, MKI67 30%, TOP2A 36%; type_confusion cDC1 vs cDC2 0.44, share second 0.95.

items.title: B cells are mostly plasma cells
items.text: Of 68 'B cells', MS4A1 is in 25% and TNFRSF17 in 49%; they lie at depth 0 next to plasma cells (log2 3.5) in the lamina propria, not in follicles (COL-07 expects B cells in follicles). There are no follicles here, so most are plasma cells; B vs plasma confusion 0.31.

action.request: Tighten B cells (MS4A1+ required, TNFRSF17-) for colon 167799.

check.reason: The B cells lie in the lamina propria among plasma cells and half express the plasma-cell gene; small but consistent.
check.evidence: B cells MS4A1 25%, TNFRSF17 49%; spatial_profile depth 0 (q3 34 µm), neighbour Plasma cells log2 3.5; B vs plasma confusion 0.31; too few cells (68) to sub-cluster.

items.title: Draw the mucosa so U-1 and COL-01 apply
items.text: Your prior U-1 (no Paneth cells, sigmoid colon) and COL-01 (epithelium only in the mucosa) are region rules, and no region is drawn on this section, so they cannot act. Today no Paneth cells are called and epithelium sits at depth 0, so nothing conflicts; drawing the mucosa makes the rules guard later rounds.

action.request: Draw the mucosa of 167799 from epithelial and telocyte cells (preview_compartment) and propose it.

check.reason: The user's U-1 rule needs a mucosa region and none is drawn here.
check.evidence: list: regions_drawn [] (sample_context); U-1 rule kind=region regions=[mucosa]; 0 Paneth cells and epithelium at depth 0 (spatial_profile), so no conflict now.

items.title: Epithelial transcript spill-over into stroma
items.text: 59% of non-epithelial cells within 10 µm of epithelium carry epithelial markers (10% beyond 60 µm); telocytes are EPCAM+ in 55%. With EPCAM- on T cells and plasma cells, intraepithelial lymphocytes can be lost (COL-09).

check.reason: The spill-over gradient is real, but it does not change what to do here: few IELs are expected in colon (COL-09), and telocytes and plasma cells are still called correctly despite EPCAM detection.
